want: the web app to read the same account list as the Android app and let me add, rename, and delete accounts
soThat: an account I add on one device shows up on the other, and the web app is not limited to a fixed hardcoded list
acceptance: the web app loads the accounts table from Supabase on startup and builds its account list from it
when the accounts table cannot be read or is empty, the web app falls back to the shipped default accounts, so it still works before the migration is run
a Manage Accounts view lists every account with its currency
the user can add a custom account with a name and a currency, and its id is derived from the name the same way Android derives it
the user can rename or delete a custom account, and a default (seeded) account cannot be deleted
the account pickers in Add Transaction, Edit Transaction, and the Transactions filter reflect the current account list, and Card Debt lists every credit account
